answer: An attacker therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 30 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The signal counter is kept in terrace and ferrous shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 30 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 40 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
